provenance.note: 26 July 2005 deluge reference layer (closed series), compiled from the CCC 'Mumbai Marooned' enquiry (the richest location-level record), NIDM and OECD studies, and press retrospectives. Depth labels only where the record documents one (11 of 35 points). COORDINATES ARE ESTIMATED LOCALITY CENTROIDS (+/- ~500 m) - no reviewed source publishes coordinates and no official 26/7 GIS inundation extent is public (see _provenance).

name: mumbai-flood-2005-hotspots
_provenance: 26 July 2005 deluge reference points, compiled 2026-07 from the Concerned Citizens' Commission report 'Mumbai Marooned' (2005, the richest location-level record), Gupta, Disaster & Development Vol 3(2) (NIDM 2009), Hallegatte et al (OECD 2010) and press retrospectives. Depth labels appear only where the record documents one (11 of 35 points). COORDINATES ARE ESTIMATED LOCALITY CENTROIDS (+/- ~500 m) - no reviewed source publishes coordinates, and no official GIS inundation extent for 26/7 is public (the Chitale Fact-Finding Committee map exists only as a report figure).

properties.name: Saki Naka junction
properties.note: Police station inundated, lockups evacuated; epicentre of the deluge on the upper Mithi.

properties.name: Vakola
properties.note: Police station under 10-11 ft; Mithi-adjacent locality.

properties.name: Jogeshwari
properties.note: Police station under 8 ft of water.

properties.name: Nehru Nagar, Kurla East
properties.note: Police station under 8 ft; Mithi-backflow inundation zone.

properties.name: Santacruz airport (runway intersection)
properties.note: Airport shut ~48 hours, 1,100+ flights cancelled; water through the international terminal.

properties.name: Mankhurd
properties.note: Severely flooded; a 264-ha de-reserved open space is part of the CCC's holding-pond critique.

properties.name: Krishna Nagar / Shantivan, Dahisar
properties.note: The Dahisar river - narrowed from >200 ft to 20-30 ft by encroachment - burst through the area.

properties.name: Guzdar Bandh, Santacruz West
properties.note: Chronic 'saucer' flooding after mangrove infill and the 2000 demolition of century-old sluice gates.

properties.name: Evergreen Society, Link Road, Malad West
properties.note: Debris-raised adjoining plot redirected floodwater through the compound wall.

properties.name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park office
properties.note: Flash flood inside the park; the Field Director's 2:30 pm warning call to Mantralaya went unheeded.

properties.name: Saki Naka landslide (Khadi No. 3)
properties.note: Hillside collapsed onto hutments; 72 deaths per court record, over 100 per residents. Fire Brigade took ~15 hours.

properties.name: Kalina
properties.note: Among the worst-hit; the local corporator testified to seeing 25-30 bodies on a single road; no power for a week.

properties.name: Air India Colony, Kalina
properties.note: Collapse of the airport extension wall caused 25 deaths (residents' association testimony).

properties.name: Kranti Nagar, Kurla
properties.note: Submerged; CCC tied its annual flooding to the airport built across the Mithi's course.

properties.name: Bail Bazaar, Kurla West
properties.note: Flooded; sits on the Mithi's four forced right-angle turns near the airport.

properties.name: Jari-Mari
properties.note: Mithi-bank slum devastated; residents on rooftops from 3:30 pm to 7 am.

properties.name: Kurla West
properties.note: Among the worst-hit; Constable Pradeep Nimbalkar drowned here after rescuing two men; ~5 days without power.

properties.name: Bandra-Kurla Complex / Kalanagar
properties.note: Inundated; CCC indicts BKC's G-Block, built on the Mithi's mouth, as a major cause of upstream flooding.

properties.name: Dharavi
properties.note: Heavily inundated by the blocked Mithi mouth.

properties.name: Mahim
properties.note: Floodwater flowed just below the railway bridge at the Mithi's mouth.

properties.name: Bandra East
properties.note: Worst-affected list; reclamation-linked drainage failure.

properties.name: Bandra West
properties.note: Worst-affected list (CCC public hearing held).

properties.name: King's Circle, Matunga
properties.note: In the CCC's Mithi-mouth inundation list; long-standing chronic flood spot.

properties.name: Dadar TT
properties.note: In the CCC's Mithi-mouth inundation list.

properties.name: Ghatkopar
properties.note: Inundated; parts without power for a week to 10 days.

properties.name: Chembur
properties.note: Flooded within hours (CCC public hearing held).

properties.name: Govandi
properties.note: Flooded within hours; a 5-year-old swept away, body never found (CCC hearing testimony).

properties.name: Andheri / Amboli
properties.note: Flooded within hours; six schoolboys swept into a nallah near Andheri station, one body recovered.

properties.name: Milan Subway
properties.note: Chronic below-grade flood spot; on BMC's post-2005 list of the 60 most flood-prone localities.

properties.name: Malad / Malad Subway
properties.note: Subway logged flooded at 3:00 pm; Malad-Marve saw unprecedented flooding after mangrove infill.

properties.name: Dahisar Subway
properties.note: Logged flooded at 3:06 pm on the 26th.

properties.name: Damunagar / Barkya Compound, Kandivli East
properties.note: A debris-blocked 15-ft nallah changed course into the compound.

properties.name: Powai (Hiranandani / lake)
properties.note: Deluge triggered a massive landslide into Powai lake; the complex had almost no power for 8 days.

properties.name: Badlapur barrage, Ulhas river
properties.note: The Ulhas barrage overflowed on the 26th evening and was completely washed away by the 27th morning.

properties.name: Kalyan
properties.note: Kalyan-Mumbra-Panvel needed volunteer rescue missions for ~10 days.
